articles.summary: ICSI refers to a specialized form of IVF, in which a single live sperm is injected directly into the center of an egg, unlike in IVF, when thousands of sperm and one to two eggs are mixed in a single dish so the sperm can swim and penetrate the egg(s) just as they do during natural fertilization.
articles.title: ICSI vs. conventional IVF: Which option is right for you?

articles.summary: While vasectomies are intended as a permanent form of male sterilization and birth control, vasectomy reversal is possible — but it’s not the only option. IVF with sperm retrieval can be a fertility after vasectomy “workaround.”
articles.title: Vasectomy reversal vs. IVF: Which option is right for you?
